Bian Hao fled Tanzhou on 1 December 952; Liu Yan, who had led the former Chu troops, submitted to the Later Zhou 'in order to protect against a potentially revanchist Southern Tang'. Hunan passes to Liu Yan's regime (the Wuping circuit of 952-963, not a Cliopatria row).

'The Southern Tang were forced to cede their territories north of the Yangtze and become a vassal of the Later Zhou'; 'Li Jing additionally had to renounce claims to emperorship'; 'The Later Zhou gained control over Huainan and almost a quarter million families.' The Southern Tang was a Later Zhou vassal from 958; in February 960 Li Jing's envoys made it a Song vassal (the suzerains' dossiers carry the vassal events).

notes:
Southern Tang (Cliopatria 960-979, 2 shapes). Cliopatria's row is wrong in three ways: it starts in 960 although the state began in October 937 (the Southern Wu 911 shape, 937-946, and the Southern Wu 947 shape, 947-959, are Southern Tang land under the wrong label; southern-wu dossier verdict wrong for the 947 shape); it runs to 979 although the state ended in January 976; and its 960 and 970 shapes (about 774,000 km2) are the 951 peak plus all of Fujian, Hunan and Guangxi, far larger than the 300,000 km2 south-of-the-Yangtze realm of 958-976. Verdict wrong for both; the corrected shape is southern-tang_958 (and the new keyframes 937, 945, 951, 953 cover 937-957).

Page budget: 2 pages opened (the Five Dynasties page is shared). The Southern Tang page is detailed on dates but gives no area and no prefecture lists, so the Jian/Ting, Hunan and Huainan regions are my readings of names (confidence 2-3 where the page names the land, 1 for Changzhou and Runzhou). Not on the pages: the Nanchang capital (infobox only, no years), the 14 prefectures of Huainan, Guilin and Wuzhou, the identity of who seized Changzhou and Runzhou, Southern Tang holdings in Hunan and Fujian after 952.

Southern Tang as a vassal (Later Zhou from 958, Song from February 960): the page says it 'became a vassal' in both cases; the suzerains' dossiers carry the vassal_start/vassal_end (later-zhou does for 958-960; northern-song should for 960-976). Counterparts needing a dossier: wuping-circuit (Liu Yan, Zhou Xingfeng, 952-963; requested already by southern-chu). Dates differ across pages: end 975 (body, Five Dynasties) vs 976 (infobox, list); Li Yu's surrender January 976 is the body's. Nanchang as a temporary capital after 961 is the infobox's; the body does not mention it.
